verdict.rationale: Muse documents event-driven behavior: once a goal or task is set, it keeps working on a schedule and in response to relevant events. Goals are tracked in a Goals tab, and Muse monitors, follows up and notifies the user when something needs attention. This is goal-driven agent autonomy, not an explicit user-authored rule or trigger system, and actions such as spending or cancelling still require approval. Missing for 10: explicit user-defined rule/trigger configuration, documentation of which event types are supported, condition-action rule syntax or UI, and independent hands-on corroboration that event triggers fire reliably.
